name: browser-use-playwright
description: The PLAYWRIGHT PROVIDER of the browser-use@1 seam (provider id `playwright`): it drives a real chromium through `playwright-core` - session lifecycle, navigate, the compact SNAPSHOT with SHORT STABLE refs, the full act vocabulary (click/type/fill/select/hover/scroll/press/upload/check/focus/waitFor/back/forward/reload), evaluate, readable extract (text/markdown/html/table/attributes/links/json), FILE screenshots, tabs, waits, downloads/network observation and storage-state reuse. It reuses the SHARED chromium launcher of this repository (`shared/browser.ts`) instead of forking a second browser stack, so `web-page`, `web-session` and this provider never launch competing browsers. It spawns a process, so it declares execution host; a deployment without a browser fails with the typed `browser-use.no-browser` error naming the exact prerequisite - never a silent fallback to a non-browser fetch.

config.description: The browser this provider drives (binary or the playwright cache, launch argv, headless), the defaults of a session (viewport, locale, timezone, user agent, proxy) and where its files live (storage state, screenshots, downloads).

headless.description: Run the shared chromium without a window. It is a LAUNCH-time setting of the shared process, so a session cannot change it.

viewport.description: Default viewport of a session (a session may override it).

userAgent.description: Default user agent of a session.

proxy.description: Default proxy of a session. `credential` is the NAME of a credentials entry, never a value: it is resolved through the credentials service at launch time.

credential.description: the NAME of the credential holding the proxy password

executablePath.description: A chromium/chrome binary to launch. Absent: playwright resolves its own cache (`PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH`).

browserArgs.description: Extra chromium argv, handed over verbatim (argv, never a shell string).

storageStateDir.description: Where the per-session storage-state files live (default `<tmpdir>/workbench-browser-use/state`), the SAME convention `web-session` uses.

screenshotDir.description: Where a screenshot without an explicit path is written (default `<tmpdir>/workbench-browser-use`; a relative value is resolved against the CWD). This provider OWNS the file it writes, so this value WINS over the host bound `plugins.browser-use-impl.screenshotDir`, and the answered path is always ABSOLUTE.

downloadDir.description: Where a session's downloads are saved (default `<storageStateDir>/downloads`).

launchTimeoutMs.description: Budget of the shared chromium launch.

defaultSession.description: The session id a call uses when it names none.

observeLimit.description: How many requests/downloads the per-session observer keeps.

sessionTtlSeconds.description: Idle seconds after which a session's context is closed (0 = never).
